comment: Independent C-first door variation for pager.c doidtrap and consumed detect.c trapped glyph predicates. Source wizard wishes set the physical trap/container, blindness preserves discovered chest/door trap glyphs, hallucination exercises guarded core rn2(20) without requiring sight. Adjust input only from C observations before comparison. Leading Space explicitly dismisses any initial welcome More before source setup. Ctrl-E invokes source wiz_detect/findit (Ctrl-F merely mapped the level and did not expose the container/door trap glyph). Use the canonical typed #wizdetect caller: the separate direct Ctrl-E admission remains an inherited dispatcher frontier outside showtrap scope. Before hallucinating, typed #whatis selects map farlook and the adjacent remembered trap, exercising the existing trap_description helper caller. Repeated no-time inspections sample both C hallucination gate branches without seed search; !help suppresses unrelated encyclopedia input.
